title: bot.ability.intuition.input
description: One turn the cognition hands its long-lived decision layer (abilities/intuition/intuition.scx) after autonomy left it unhandled [floppy fields; mosfet.py's System 1 stage, since renamed Decision].

turn.description: The body's processing turn this event belongs to, counted from 1 [floppy field].

focus.description: Instance name the bot is looking at, if any.

focus_candidates.description: Instance names that may become focus for this turn.

choices.description: The turn's choices within the decision layer's effort ceiling: {event, schema, description?, target?} each.

held.description: The actions held from this tier, over its effort ceiling: {event, description?} each.

recent.description: The recent turns of the bot's conversations.

confidence_tuner.description: The decision layer's confidence tuner state, on the 0-100 scale.

decision_timeout_ms.description: How long the decision may take, in milliseconds.

hand_ons.description: The later tiers a pass may hand the turn to.

max_context_tokens.description: The decision model's context window in tokens, or null to send every request whole.

bytes_per_token.description: The fewest bytes a token any answer showed so far.
